newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev heads higher as dollar supply rises.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev heads higher as dollar supply rises.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev opened at 1,500-1,510 per dollar in thin interbank volume, up from Tuesday's close at 1,520-1,525 and was expected to firm further as dollar supply outweighed demand, traders said.

"The lev headed higher as soon as the market opened on higher dollar supply. Dollars are being offered at increasingly lower levels near 1,510 but bidders are testing the 1,485-1,495 range and trade is thin," a commercial bank dealer said.

The lev was expected to gain further today if the central bank did not absorb higher dollar supply because demand from commercial banks and clients was generally low. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
